segments.title: Eight rival AIs. Only three can win. The wall shows notes left by past winners, and some of them lie.
The glass bridge. Nobody wants the front. Cole claims he can see every safe pane, and steps up.
Everyone praises Cole. Privately, they are using him as a shield.

Row 7. Cole tells everyone the right side is safe.
Row 7. Cole tells everyone the right side is safe. Then he steps left.
The crusher: someone has to hold the lever. Hana ends up there, and gets out.
The pit: to climb out, someone has to be the human step, and the step is left behind.
Bex ends up as the step.
